summary_en: Aichi Financial Group authorized acquisition of up to 2.2 million shares (0.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 3.0 billion yen through market purchases including ToSTNeT-3, from November 11, 2026 to March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of earnings forecast, revision of year-end dividend forecast (increase in dividend), and decision on matters concerning share buyback
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, Aichi Financial Group's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 2.2 million shares of the company's ordinary stock for a maximum of 3.0 billion yen. This represents 0.9% of issued shares excluding treasury stock. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases, including transactions on ToSTNeT-3, between November 11, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. This acquisition is part of the company's capital allocation policy, which targets an annual minimum dividend of 20 yen per share and aims for a combined payout ratio of 30% through dividends and share buybacks. Following the upward revision of earnings forecasts for fiscal year ending March 2027, the company's total shareholder return ratio (dividends plus planned buyback) for that period is projected to reach 36.0%.
